record.paper_title: Open Problems in the Topology of Manifolds
record.original_question: Give a satisfactory proof that any two locally flat topological embeddings of a closed oriented surface in S^4 whose complement has infinite cyclic fundamental group are homeomorphic.

evidence.quote: Kawauchi has published several accounts of the theorem below; however, none of them are satisfactory. The problem is to give a satisfactory proof.
Theorem. Any two locally flat topological embeddings of a closed oriented surface in S4 whose complement has infinite cyclic fundamental group are homeomorphic.

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $\Sigma$ be a closed oriented surface and let $f_0, f_1 \colon \Sigma \hookrightarrow S^4$ be two locally flat topological embeddings of $\Sigma$ into the 4-sphere. Assume that for each $i \in \{0,1\}$ the fundamental group of the complement satisfies
$$\pi_1\!\left(S^4 \setminus f_i(\Sigma)\right) \cong \mathbb{Z}.$$
Provide a rigorous proof of the following statement: there exists a homeomorphism $h \colon S^4 \to S^4$ with $h \circ f_0 = f_1$ (equivalently, the pairs $(S^4, f_0(\Sigma))$ and $(S^4, f_1(\Sigma))$ are homeomorphic as pairs).
artifact.status_search_result: A complete and satisfactory proof has been given for genus g ≥ 3 (and subsequently extended) by Conway and Powell in "Embedded surfaces with infinite cyclic knot group" (arXiv:2009.13461, Geometry & Topology 27 (2023)), which provides a topological uniqueness result for locally flat closed orientable surfaces in simply connected 4-manifolds (in particular S^4) with infinite cyclic complement group. Some low-genus cases (notably genus 1, 2) and full ambient isotopy details have required further corrections/extensions, so the problem cannot be regarded as completely settled across all genera, but substantial parts have been resolved.

status_evidence.title: Embedded surfaces with infinite cyclic knot group (arXiv)
status_evidence.snippet: Algebraic-topological criteria for two locally flat surfaces with infinite cyclic complement to be related by an ambient homeomorphism; revisions to several theorems noted.
status_evidence.claim: Conway–Powell establish topological classification results for surfaces in 4-manifolds with infinite cyclic complement, giving a proof of the unknotting theorem in high genus.

status_evidence.title: Embedded surfaces with infinite cyclic knot group (Geometry & Topology 27, 2023)
status_evidence.snippet: Treats Z-surfaces in simply connected 4-manifolds and Alexander polynomial one knots; partial progress on classification.
status_evidence.claim: Published version establishes uniqueness up to homeomorphism for surfaces with Z complement under genus hypotheses, leaving some cases requiring further work.
